data.narrative:
LabGenius is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by James Field that has raised $73M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public Biotech & Health peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the same sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. Stage-Progression anchors on a $27M base value derived from total capital raised and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $68M. Peer-Median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Biotech & Health cohort—while 8 private peers exist in the sector, none met the threshold of ≥3 datapoints within aligned stage and valuation bands. Public-Comp Anchoring, though supported by a 5.5x median P/S across the three public tickers, cannot proceed without LabGenius's revenue, which private companies rarely disclose.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $57M (low) to $78M (median high), centered on $68M. This single-method triangulation carries meaningful uncertainty: the absence of peer multiples leaves the analysis reliant on a mechanical stage-progression assumption rather than validated market comparables. Revenue disclosure would enable public-market anchoring and substantially narrow the range.
